boatApiKey.title: Boat API Key
boatApiKey.description: Boat API Key from noforeignland.com. Can be found in Account > Settings > Boat tracking > API Key.

minMove.title: Minimum boat move to upload in meters
minMove.description: A position is only sent to noforeignland.com when the boat has moved at least this far since the last one sent (0 sends every position)

minSpeed.title: Minimum boat speed to upload in knots
minSpeed.description: A position is only sent when the boat was moving at least this fast as it was recorded, which leaves out swinging at anchor or on a mooring (0 disables the check)

sendWhileMoving.title: Attempt sending location while moving
sendWhileMoving.description: Should the plugin attempt to send tracking data to NFL while detecting the vessel is moving or only when stopped?

ping_api_every_24h.title: Force a send every 24 hours
ping_api_every_24h.description: Keeps your boat active on NFL in your current location even if you do not move

trackFrequency.title: Minimum time between uploaded positions in seconds
trackFrequency.description: The Tracks plugin records a position every minute by default. Uploaded positions are kept at least this far apart (0 sends every recorded position)

apiCron.title: Send attempt CRON
apiCron.description:
We send the tracking data to NFL once in a while, you can set the schedule with this setting.
CRON format: https://crontab.guru/

apiTimeout.title: API request timeout in seconds
apiTimeout.description: Timeout for sending data to NFL API. Increase for slow connections.
